# Jide Lambo

> Software designer who builds products. Site: https://jidelambo.com

Personal site for Jide Lambo. Nav: Home, About, Writing. Hosted on Vercel.

## About

- Bio and career: https://jidelambo.com/about
- Full-time: Senior Product Designer at Sinch (inbox and AI for messaging at scale)
- Building: FirstDistro, UseLay
- Earlier products (shut down): Wonderstand, TokiApp
- Earlier roles: Nordcloud (IBM / BMW Public Cloud Platform), BCaster (founding design engineer), GTBank (GTWorld app)

## Products

- [FirstDistro](https://firstdistro.com): Account intelligence that catches silent churn and proves the revenue you kept
- [UseLay](https://uselay.com): In-app feedback that lets users point at what's broken instead of describing it
- Sinch: Employer only (https://sinch.com). Not a founder product

## Writing

Index: https://jidelambo.com/writing

- [Dashboards don't save accounts](https://jidelambo.com/writing/dashboards-dont-save-accounts): Visibility is not a finished outcome. Catch the risk, save the account, prove the dollars.
- [Saved revenue as a receipt](https://jidelambo.com/writing/saved-revenue-as-a-receipt): Health scores warn. Saved revenue is the receipt after you act.
- [Which customers need you this week](https://jidelambo.com/writing/which-customers-need-you-this-week): A 15-minute Monday triage: health trend, silence, renewal proximity.
- [Clear Jobs, not a call center](https://jidelambo.com/writing/clear-jobs-not-a-call-center): Why FirstDistro skipped a general-purpose agent harness and shipped clear AI jobs, context, and MCP.
- [I'm done gatekeeping SaaS playbooks](https://jidelambo.com/writing/im-done-gatekeeping-saas-playbooks): The account-intelligence playbook behind FirstDistro, open enough to rebuild yourself.
